content:
The GPT-4o Era Is Coming to an End

OpenAI has decided to streamline the variety of models on the ChatGPT platform. In a statement released by the company, it was noted that certain older versions, including GPT-4o, will be removed from the platform as of February 13.

The primary reason cited for the decision was a shift in user habits. According to data, a large portion of ChatGPT users are now conducting their tasks using the GPT-5.2 model, which features a newer architecture. Low usage rates and the need for resource optimization have accelerated the process of phasing out GPT-4o.

  • Models to Be Removed: GPT-4o and related sub-versions.
  • Shutdown Date: February 13.
  • Focused Model: GPT-5.2.

This change aims to allow OpenAI to use its computing power more efficiently and focus its development efforts on the most up-to-date models.
